payload.question_text: A customer-service manager needs an app to pull key phrases from customer emails, not analyze images or transcribe calls. Which approach should the manager choose?

options.better_fit: Use this for spoken language or speech-text conversion.

options.error_type: Confuses technique with industry use case

options.better_fit: Use this in retail to suggest products to shoppers.

feedback.intrinsic: The manager would get product suggestions instead of key phrases.
